predictions: Pretty clearly finding my average now, as I posted my third straight week with a 19-7 record. That brings me to 123-59 (67.6% correct) for the season. I've already gotten at least one pick wrong for all but 3 teams, so I've got that going for me… sigh. Anyway, at least not everybody is a Main Street Mayhem or a Cheap Shots - with each of those two I posted a stellar 1-6 record in the first half. 1 and 6. And the Dart Bags are my 2-5 record in their matches isn't very far behind.

Match of the week: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Village Idiots. With Hump Day going down at the hands of the Kids last week, the B race is back on the table. And the red hot Idiots are one of the primary newly re-minted contenders. If the Idiots can take the Humpers to a losing streak, the top of B is going to be very crowded. However… I don't think Hump Day has any intentions of dropping another here. 14-10.

Match #2: (F Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Sharky's Machine. F is one of those weird divisions where four different teams hold the current best win-loss record in the four sets. Division-leading Dartness has the best 501 record, while losing-record Machine has the best DCkt record. How does the best doubles cricket team have a losing record?! I don't know, but they do. And they're about to lose another. 14-10.

Match #3: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Liquor Possee. The Possee just got the critical win over the Mafia, so there is always potential for that next-week-letdown. Add to that the fact that Sanchez is one of the most dangerous bottom-half teams in any division, and this match has alarm bells all over it. Possee survives, but only by 13-11.

Match #4: (E Div.) Dartifacts @ Dart Knights. After dropping their big week 6 showdown, Dartifacts rebounded with a massive win last week. Now they get their old rivals, the Knights, once again. While the Knights sit with a losing record, any time has a couple of the best throwers in a division, an upset is in play. Dartifacts get by, 15-9.

Match #5: (G Div.) Throwin' on the Bayou @ She-nanigans. It seems like it was just about an hour ago that She-nanigans was in the G title chase. And now they have to face a Bayou team that all of a sudden has a taste for victories. I think Bayou makes it three straight! 13-11.

Match #6: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Inconsistent Consistently. The fight among the RDL's 4th-7th teams is on to see who stays in A next season. I don't really know how Darty Minds only has one win so far, but I fear that's where they'll stay this week. IC, 13-11.

Match #7: (E Div.) Runs with Corks @ Cheap Shots. Kind of an important swing match here in the middle of E, but does it matter at all who I pick (to my pick rate, I mean)? This is a Cheapies match, so I got this wrong before I even started typing. Sorry, Cork; 13-11.
Match #8: (D Div.) Bottoms Up @ One Dart Wonders. Bottoms Up is in a near dead-heat with Mayhem, so the task now is to avoid dangerous hurdles like this until they meet again. Bottoms, 15-9.

Match #9: (F Div.) Nein Mark @ Sofa Kings. Dartness is in front, with Nein Mark close behind. But the Kings are in third and control a lot of their own fate. Nein nips a bit of that here though, 14-10.

Match #10: (E Div.) Rippin Darts @ Aim For Fame. It's about that time where we start seeing matches that will go a long way toward determining which teams are likely to drop a division next season. Here's an E division version… Fame pulls an important win, 14-10.
Match #11: (F Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Bangin the Wire. Aaaand… see the note for match #10 above. Here is the F division version… This one goes the distance. Throw It in 1001.
Match #12: (B Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Double In Stumble Out. And we make it a trio with the B version… Secrets eke it out, 13-11.
